title: Photos, voice notes and files in WhatsApp groups now open
text: In a WhatsApp group, a photo, voice note, video or file sent by a member used to show only as a grey label like [Photo]. They now open like in a one-to-one chat: the picture, the voice player and the file. Items from the last 25 days are picked up automatically; older ones are no longer available from WhatsApp.

steps.name: Open a group chat
steps.detail: The one with the green Group label.

steps.name: Find the photo, voice note or file
steps.detail: It shows within a couple of minutes of arriving.

steps.name: Click to open or play
steps.detail: The same as in a one-to-one chat.
